full_prompt_en: A cinematic photographic portrait depicts a blond young man seated behind an elaborately laid dining table in a nearly black room. He occupies the centre of the square frame, wearing a black shirt with an open collar. His face turns down toward the left, and one raised hand rests against the side of his neck behind his ear. Swept-back hair catches amber highlights, while his shoulders merge into the dark background. Ornate branching metal candelabra flank him on both sides. Their slender, curled arms support pale taper candles at staggered heights, with small bright flames rising above them. The left group spreads across the foreground, and another gold-toned group stands beside his right shoulder. Beneath them, a muted brown tablecloth stretches across the lower part of the image. Stacked plates with reflective rims sit directly in front of the man. Clear stemmed glassware, smaller vessels, and scattered pieces of cutlery fill the surrounding table. A tall goblet on the right catches narrow vertical glints. Short candles in glass holders add lower points of light near the plates. Their reflections break into small amber flecks on polished metal and glass. A fragment of richly textured dark decoration appears high on the left; the rest of the room remains indistinct. Warm illumination picks out the man's forehead, cheek, fingers, and strands of hair, leaving deep shadow across his shirt. The upright candles frame his lowered pose, and the layered table settings form a broad base beneath him. Gold and amber accents emerge from subdued brown and black, giving the still scene a solemn, enclosed atmosphere.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅具有电影氛围的摄影肖像：金发青年坐在布置精致的餐桌后，房间几乎全黑。他位于方形画面中央，身穿敞开领口的黑衬衫，脸转向左下方，一只抬起的手贴着耳后颈侧。向后梳起的头发接住琥珀色亮光，双肩融入深暗背景。人物两侧立着装饰繁复的分枝金属烛台，纤细卷曲的烛臂托起高低错落的浅色细蜡烛，小而明亮的火苗从顶端升起。左侧烛台组铺展在前景，另一组金色烛台靠近他的右肩。下方，低调棕色桌布横贯画面底部，带反光边沿的叠放餐盘就在男子面前。透明高脚杯、小型器皿和零散餐具分布其间，右侧较高的酒杯映出窄竖光。餐盘附近的玻璃烛杯中还有较矮蜡烛，增加低处亮点；反光在抛光金属与玻璃表面碎成细小琥珀色闪烁。左上方露出一小段肌理繁复的深色装饰，房间其余部分难以辨明。暖光照亮男子的额头、脸颊、手指和发丝，衬衫仍陷在深阴影中。直立蜡烛围住低垂的人物姿态，层层餐具在下方形成宽阔基底。金色与琥珀色从沉静棕黑色中浮现，营造出庄重而封闭的静止氛围。
style_prompt_en: Cinematic photographic realism preserves fine reflective highlights and gentle focus falloff. This visual language uses concentrated warm highlights surrounded by deep, soft-edged darkness. Gold, amber and brown tones gather around the focal area, while black negative space absorbs most detail. Small luminous points repeat across a horizontal plane and create rhythm; reflective surfaces scatter them into broken glints. Directional low light models only selected contours, allowing other forms to recede gradually. Fine tonal shifts preserve a sense of material without hard contrast everywhere. Vertical accents balance a broad low plane, and the close composition feels intimate and restrained. Its atmosphere comes from warm light held within substantial shadow.
style_prompt_zh: 电影感摄影写实保留精细反光亮点与柔和的清晰度衰减。这种视觉语言以集中暖色亮部和边缘柔和的深暗区域为特点。金色、琥珀色与棕色汇聚在焦点周围，黑色负空间则吸收大部分细节。细小亮点沿水平面重复排列，形成节奏；反光表面将光点打散成零碎闪烁。低位方向光只塑造部分轮廓，让其他形体逐渐退入暗处。细腻色调过渡保留材质感，却不让全画面都充满强反差。竖向点缀与宽阔低平面相互平衡，近距离构图显得亲密而克制。整体氛围来自暖光被深沉阴影包围的关系。
theme_en: A young man in a black open-collar shirt leans at a candlelit dining table, his face turned down and left
theme_zh: 一名年轻男子穿黑色开领衫倚在烛光餐桌旁，低头转向左侧
name: Candlelit
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
